messages:
carmen (AE): Quick preflight  Horizon Financial wants a 10-day POC. Requirements: SSO (Okta), SCIM delta + bulk, RBAC mapping from groups, domain TXT proofing, and a short hosted vs dedicated note for procurement. Can we confirm limits and a small curl example?

leo (SE): We support SAML 2.0 (signed) and Okta metadata upload. SCIM RFC7644: PATCH/PUT/POST/DELETE, ETag via If-Match for safe deltas. Default SCIM rate limit 10 req/s per tenant; Dedicated can increase. Bulk endpoint available for seeding large directories.

leo (SE): RBAC: map SCIM groups to Redwood roles using group.externalId; attribute-based rules supported via policy engine.

tara (Security): Quick security notes: CMK supported in Dedicated/Private. TLS 1.2+ required. Audit logs default retention 90 days, extendable. We redact PII in exported reports; raw SCIM payloads restricted to admin roles.

carmen (AE): Procurement blurb request: just a 2-sentence compare hosted eval vs dedicated commit.

leo (SE): Draft: "Hosted eval: fastest to start, logical tenant isolation, usage-based pricing, no SLA for eval. Dedicated: isolated capacity with VPC options, full CMK support, configurable rate limits and SLA; priced on commit (typical entry ~ $20k+/mo)."

carmen (AE): Perfect. Can you paste a minimal SCIM PATCH example they can run?

leo (SE): Sample PATCH with If-Match:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/abc123" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "If-Match: \"etag123\"" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","value":{"active":false}}]}'
```

ops-bot: Provisioned POC tenant 'horizon-poc-2026' in us-east-1. Temp creds delivered to carmen via DM.

carmen (AE): Thanks all  I'll ask Horizon to upload IdP metadata and a sample CSV for seeding. Tara I'll DM the security questionnaire. Will update here after kickoff."
